verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Capacities has a block-based editor: templates prefill blocks, blocks can be embedded and referenced across pages, and images become reusable image objects. A user also calls it Notion-like and notes media handling as reusable entities. Nothing documents the specific formatting elements or a keyboard-driven editing workflow. missing for 10: headings, callouts, tables, code blocks, keyboard shortcuts/slash-command editing, editor speed evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of formatting.
